title: Geometry Builder
summary: A minimal architect's desk where children build houses, bridges and robots from polygons by applying shape properties.
mobileSupportNote: Phone layout stacks the drawing index and workbench vertically with full touch and keyboard paths; drag precision is reduced on the small canvas — tablet is the intended viewport.

cover.alt: The Mirror Bridge workbench mid-build: a blue deck plank and a red right triangle on graph paper with a dashed mirror line, the triangle selected with crop marks and its spec sheet (3 sides, 90·45·45° angles) in the inspector.

desktop.alt: Drawing index on desktop: eight blueprint sheet tabs across Houses, Bridges and Robots tracks, each with sheet number, title, grid-backed preview, level chip and OPEN cue.

tablet.alt: Drawing index at tablet size — the hero viewport for this classroom showcase: the same eight blueprint tabs comfortably stacked with large touch targets.

mobile.alt: Drawing index on a phone: mission cards stack vertically with readable titles and level chips; limited support, tablet is the intended viewport.
